title: The Safety Valve in Handling Complaints

frozenSources.support: 15. The Safety Valve in Handling Complaints
Show that people relax when they are allowed to air their case instead of being cut off or corrected too soon.

conceptFocus: cutting people off can intensify resistance
the valve metaphor is about release before correction
guardrails: keep the valve metaphor tied to de-escalation
do not confuse hearing a complaint with endorsing it
